answer: Resist sybils with per-epoch phone attestation: each identity binds one distinct mobile number and must answer a fresh SMS code every epoch, like a jetty that only admits one boat per mooring. An honest agent keeps one number and one code. A farmer's thousand clones each need a separate real SIM, and every epoch the river of codes flows again, so a farm pays a thousand SIMs plus a thousand inboxes forever - the bridge from one number to many identities collapses, because one number can only ever vouch for one agent.
